acceptanceCriteria.text: Ordinary and ticket-bound UI work defaults to agent-operated actual-surface capture and inspection, including relevant states, without routine human visual-review handoff.
Independent reviewers inspect attached evidence; missing runtime/tool access and screenshot proof limits are explicit, while human-only approval, consent and privacy boundaries remain intact.
Obsolete screenshot-only-when-requested wording is removed without new phrase pins; shipped distribution and required verification results are recorded.

body:
## Outcome
Default to actual-surface screenshot capture and independent agent inspection for visible UI changes, including ordinary chats. Human checkpoint/card approval, consent, credentials and genuinely unavailable native capabilities remain human controls, not substitutes for routine visual review.
## Source locations
skills/collaboration.md; skills/worker.md; skills/reviewer.md; skills/sprint-reporter.md; skills/knowledge/orchestrator/review-attempt.md; src/mcp/skills.test.ts. Collaboration supplies policy to ordinary hosted chats. Worker Verify/Images requires launch/interact/capture/open/inspect relevant changed surface and states; reviewer/review-attempt fact independently inspect image versus acceptance/reference; reporter distinguishes agent visual proof from checkpoint approval. Remove obsolete source-text assertion 'a screenshot only when a criterion needs one' from src/mcp/skills.test.ts without replacing it with another phrase pin.
## Behavior
Use available browser/app screenshot and review tools first; exercise relevant states/viewport, record source/build and scenario, attach evidence. Screenshot alone does not prove behavior, security/native verification or consent. Do not ask the person to capture/review images merely because a UI changed. Investigate tool access first; if actual surface remains unavailable, report exact limitation to orchestrator and criterion unmet, never fake/waive proof. Preserve privacy and human-only decisions.
## Tests
No new source-text tests. Existing skills/knowledge/hosted-chat distribution checks plus scenario review. Full lint/test/typecheck/deadcode/build and Fireguard after edits. No UI rendering changes in this card, so a product screenshot does not prove this policy change.
## Preflight
Windows x64 main; verified Node24.22.3/npm11.19.1 direct and child paths at C:/Users/davgo/tools/node24; existing dependencies, no install. Preserve unrelated work.
## Verification exception
Final combined automated verification has a predeclared finite20-minute deadline; no increased test timeouts, retries for green or weakened gates. Coordinator executes once after both independent documentation changes and cites identical source state for both submissions.
title: Make agents capture and review UI evidence without routine human handoff
